_comment: Transcribed from the in-game customisation screens, captured 2026-08-06 (Steam captures 20260806011221-011900 and 023313-023457). Point cost is the number on the tile; every weapon has 100 points to spend across all slots. Name and description are identical on every weapon that takes it, verified across the eleven assault rifles in that run. One page rather than thirty: EA writes one description per magnification band, so 22 of the 30 optics would otherwise carry the same sentence. The model name, magnification and point cost are what actually differ, so they are rows here. Each row now has its own page; this one stays as the family index and as the home for patch lines that name no single model.

_alias_note: No bare "sight" alias. "Aiming down sights" is a movement/aiming mechanic that EA writes on almost every weapon line, and it matched 60+ lines that have nothing to do with optics. "scope" is safe: the boundary rule treats a hyphen as part of the word, so "quick-scoping" does not match.
